headline: How long has something been blocking me from a nest egg?
note: generated from REVIEW-new-voice.md — not a wired draft

a: You turned the Magician. You couldn't see them, and your hand went to the worker of the three.
Look at his hands. Both busy, and neither one empty.
You asked how long something has been blocking your nest egg. What catches me is how full both those hands are.
And yet nothing has gathered. And you're asking me how long it's been that way.
Something turns up at the point where things would start to build. I don't think this began with you.
Let me look closer at what's holding it…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. Nothing marked the backs, and you took the one held at one ankle.
Look at the rope. One ankle, and the rest of him hangs loose.
You asked how long something has been blocking your nest egg. One rope holds all of it.
Still, nothing has gathered. And how long is what you want from me.
Something has a quiet hold on this, and it doesn't shift. I don't think it started with you.
Let me look closer at what that is…
c: You turned the Fool. Face down, all three, and you chose the one travelling light.
Look at the bundle on his stick. That's all he owns.
You asked how long something has been blocking your nest egg. A small bundle, and a step already taken — that's what stops me here.
But nothing has gathered. And you're the one asking how long that's gone on.
Something sits right where it would gather. I don't think any of it began with you.
Let me look closer at what's sitting there…
